question: In which of the following Nobel Peace Prize Concerts did Ustad Amjad Ali Khan perform the ‘Rage for Peace’ along with his sons Ayaan Ali Khan and Amaan Ali Khan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Khan performed "**Raga For Peace**" during the 2014 Nobel Peace Prize Concert alongside his two sons, **Ayaan Ali Khan and Amaan Ali Khan.**
 
• The **21st Rajiv Gandhi National Sadbhavna Award** went to Khan.
 
• Khan began his American tour in 1963
